item.title: Man shot and killed in Atwater, police say
item.description: The Atwater Police Department is looking for the suspect or suspects who killed a man late Monday night, marking the second homicide in the city this year.

item.title: Merced County deputies searching for missing 70-year-old man
item.description: Investigators say someone dropped Richard Daly off near Highway 59 at the Merced River Bridge to float the river to the Shaffer Bridge on a blue raft.

item.title: Life skills center in Fresno empowers kids and families with speech support
item.description: The staff at Empower Speech Therapy and Life Skills Center in Northeast Fresno is helping Robert and Danielle navigate through Lucien's early developmental stages.

item.title: Dog seeks a forever home after veteran owner passes away
item.description: Neighbors and good Samaritans in Madera have launched a call for help after a veteran died and left behind two German shepherds.

item.title: Vehicle crashes into power pole, leaving many without power in Madera
item.description: A vehicle has crashed into a power pole on Granada Drive between National and Sunset avenues, leaving 2,985 customers without power.

item.description: President Trump used his State of the Union address to sell a booming America, even as voters worry about the economy.

item.title: Lawmakers propose pausing California gas tax as prices climb
item.description: Some state lawmakers are proposing a temporary pause to California's gas tax as prices at the pump continue to rise, leaving drivers in the state paying among the highest fuel costs in the country.

item.title: 1 person hospitalized after house catches fire in Southeast Fresno
item.description: Investigators are trying to determine what sparked a house fire that left one person hospitalized in Southeast Fresno.

item.title: Bulldog Breakdown: Fresno State swim and dive team Mountain West Championship
item.description: Action News spoke with the team's coach, Jeanne Fleck, about the Bulldog swimmers' recent success and their hopes for improvement after Mackenzie Miller-Lung clinched a spot in next month's NCAA Championships.
